The Chicago Fed National Financial Conditions Index (NFCI) is -0.524, indicating easing financial conditions. The corporate credit spread is 0.76, suggesting healthy credit markets. The liquidity regime is classified as easing, and the overall risk regime is currently "risk-on."

5. Yield Curve Interpretation
The 10-year/2-year Treasury yield spread is positive at 0.47%, which typically signals expectations of future economic growth and a healthy economic outlook.

6. Equity Risk Regime (Risk-On / Neutral / Risk-Off)
Risk-On

7. Confidence Score (1-10)
8
